name: CallGemini
description: Voice-first chat with Gemini Live — talk, see the dialog transcribed live, and wire in your own MCP tools. Serves an MCP server to add/remove per-conversation MCP servers at runtime.

provides.name: mcp-servers
provides.description: MCP server to list, add and remove a conversation's temporary MCP servers (an add/remove re-dials a live call with the new tools, context kept).

store.longDescription: Voice-first chat with Google Gemini Live, as an AuraOS window. Talk to the model and watch both sides of the dialog transcribed live; conversations are kept so you can resume an earlier one. The audio path is built for real calls rather than push-to-talk: browser-side voice activity detection, RNNoise denoising, gain staging, a dynamic jitter cushion, and local barge-in so you can interrupt mid-sentence. You can also register your own MCP tools and let the model call them during a call. Set GEMINI_API_KEY in AuraOS Context, or paste a key in the app settings on first run.
